settings.description:
ViBeauty's journey began with our interest in smart and hypoallergenic solutions for nail technicians in the luxury nail industry. We spent a lot of time searching for the best products and manicure products to meet the full needs of professionals and beginners alike, so we opted for the professional manicure brand PNB and the vegan brand Joia. Each ingredient in our products meets the highest standards of quality, safety, effectiveness, and environmental responsibility, having all the necessary certifications for the European countries.

Our mission is to improve the European nail service market by providing a safe, hypoallergenic, premium quality product that will be available to every nail technician, safe for the health of the technician and the client, and friendly to nature and animals.

The safety of PNB and Joia products for the health of our customers is our most important task and strategic goal.
settings.highlights_description:
Development is the most important trend of the 21st century, so we develop ourselves and create such an opportunity for everyone. Our ViBeauty Nail Academy has created courses for both beginners and professional nail technicians who want to improve their skills. The training takes place using products of the professional brand PNB, so you have the opportunity not only to improve your skills, but also to get new sensations from working with a new brand for you.

Contact us for more details at nailacademy@vibeauty.nl

settings.description: High-quality products with certification that confirms the quality. Our goal is to help you find a product that perfectly matches your needs and values while being honest. At ViBeauty, you can be sure that every product you buy is a priority for both your well-being and the environment.
We are always happy to hear that you are interested in working with us. If you want to collaborate with ViBeauty, please contact us in English: info@vibeauty.nl

To receive the latest information about new brands and products,
you can subscribe to our newsletter.Don't forget to follow us on PNB Instagram or JOIA Instagram to stay informed of the latest trends, the best promotions and a giveaway every now and then!

settings.main_block_description:
We strongly believe in the power of community and connections. Our mission is to bring together nail technicians and trainers who share our passion for quality training and products for the nail industry.

We create meaningful offline meetings where we are confident that each of
you will not only meet new people, but also be able to share your experience and knowledge.

Thanks to this community of professionals, we can contribute to positive changes and improve the quality of training and products in the Benelux territory.

We believe that our unity will help to create a real impact on the development of this area and contribute to the professional development of each participant.

For all those who use our brands, we have developed a loyalty system and various partnership programmes to reward your loyalty and support. Details and terms and conditions can be found here.
